title: Terms on Which Northbeam Renew Trade-In Credit Is Settled and Spent
content:
Trade-in credit issued under Northbeam Renew Trade-In is settled and spent on the terms of the programme the agreement was written under. The forms the credit may take, whether it may be taken off a purchase at the till the same day, how long it stays spendable, whether it may be passed to another profile, the smallest amount that may be spent at once and whether it may be spent a little at a time are all the programme's own terms.

| Renew programme | Forms the credit may take | Taken off a purchase at the till the same day | Days the credit stays spendable | May be passed to another profile | Smallest amount spendable at once, USD | May be spent a little at a time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renew Instant Store Quote | instant discount at the till or store credit | yes | 180 | no | 1.00 | yes |
| Renew Mail In Appraisal | store credit or gift card | no | 365 | no | 1.00 | yes |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | instant discount at the till or store credit | yes | 365 | no | 1.00 | yes |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | instant discount at the till or store credit | yes | 365 | no | 1.00 | yes |
| Renew Business Asset Buyback | invoice credit or bank transfer | no | 90 | yes | 25.00 | no |
| Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement | invoice credit or bank transfer | no | 90 | yes | 25.00 | no |

Hypothetical illustration of the columns read together. Credit issued on a Renew Business Asset Buyback agreement stays spendable for 90 days, may be passed to another profile, and must be spent in one transaction of at least 25.00 USD, because that programme does not allow spending a little at a time. Credit issued on a Renew Mail In Appraisal agreement stays spendable for 365 days, stays with the profile it was issued to, and may be drawn on in amounts of 1.00 USD or more.
